intro: Rising Spirit is a ritual blessing offered by the captured Razormane geomancer Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo. In exchange for blood shards wrested from his Bristleback rivals, Mangletooth channels the ancient power of Agamaggan to invigorate a champion's willpower and spiritual fortitude.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Warriors of all types have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess in battle.
Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Our greatest warriors, and our greatest shamans would envy your will, traveler.
Defeat more of the Bristlebacks knowing that they cannot stop you!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
